contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ SOLI INVICTO COMITI

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe; in field T F. Reverse inscription: SOLI INVICTO COMITI. In exergue: PTR, for first officina, Trier mint. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, which has a U-shaped nibble from its edge. Diameter: 22.2mm, Weight: 2.89gms, die axis: 6
